image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a butterfly resting on a light-colored, textured rock surface. The butterfly has its wings held vertically closed. The visible ventral side of the hindwing is pale greyish-brown with a distinct row of dark brown spots and a larger orange patch containing a black eyespot (ocellus) near the apex. The forewing shows a similar orange patch with an eyespot. The body is fuzzy/hairy and brown. One antenna is clearly visible and clubbed. Legs are thin and spindly, gripping the rock.
